HARUKA_KEYWORD_BUBBLE.description: When you are about to take attack damage exceeding your Block, a [gold]Bubble[/gold] is [gold]Evoked[/gold] and grants [gold]Block[/gold] equal to its stacks.
HARUKA_KEYWORD_BUBBLE.title: Bubble
HARUKA_KEYWORD_SCARE.title: Scare
HARUKA_KEYWORD_SCARE.description: Reduce your [gold]Emotion value[/gold] by the specified amount.
HARUKA_KEYWORD_INSPIRE.title: Inspire
HARUKA_KEYWORD_INSPIRE.description: Increase your [gold]Emotion value[/gold] by the specified amount.
HARUKA_KEYWORD_CALM.title: Soothe
HARUKA_KEYWORD_CALM.description: Move your [gold]Emotion value[/gold] toward 0 by the specified amount.
HARUKA_KEYWORD_CHANNEL_ON_FRONT.title: Channel at the Front
HARUKA_KEYWORD_CHANNEL_ON_FRONT.descript: Existing Orbs move backward, and the rearmost Orb is [gold]Evoked[/gold].
HARUKA_KEYWORD_MIO.title: Mio
HARUKA_KEYWORD_MIO.description:
(HP 12/12)
While [gold]Mio[/gold] is on the field, she takes half of [gold]Haruka[/gold]'s HP loss. If she enters the field again while already present, she recovers all HP.
HARUKA_KEYWORD_FLOAT.title: Levitate
HARUKA_KEYWORD_FLOAT.description:
Deals 50% less damage.
Falls after taking attack damage or at the end of its turn, taking [blue]10[/blue] damage and gaining 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
